entities.name: Devanagari Acoustic Relay for Tribal TTS
entities.content: Android TTS acoustic engines (hi-IN) do not natively synthesize Ol Chiki (Santhali) or Warang Chiti (Ho) script glyphs. All tribal phonetic synthesis routes through Devanagari transliteration with 0.72x FLN rate calibration and 450ms bilingual pause relay.

entities.name: Windows Gradle JVM Native Heap Allocation Boundary
entities.content: To prevent fatal JVM native memory exhaustion (malloc failed / arena.cpp:168) on Windows, gradle.properties enforces: org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m and org.gradle.workers.max=2.

entities.name: Offline-First Durable Outbox Reconciliation
entities.content: All edge transactions (lesson generation, student assessment attempts, teacher approvals) are committed first to Room SQLite outbox with idempotent UUIDs, then synchronized to NestJS /api/v1/sync/push via append-only merge and teacher-authoritative conflict resolution.

entities.name: Hybrid RAG JCERT Retrieval Engine
entities.content: JCERT state primary school curriculum nodes (15 verified nodes across Grades 1-5) are indexed with BM25 lexical tokenization plus BAAI/bge-m3 dense embeddings, achieving 100% recall@1 with sub-millisecond retrieval latency (0.64ms avg).
